name: O3b / O3b mPOWER (MEO comms)
description: 20 satellites at 8,063 km equatorial MEO — only operational MEO commercial broadband. O3b mPOWER successors launching since 2022 with software-defined beam allocation. Lower latency than GEO, more coverage than LEO; aimed at the 'other 3 billion' (origin of the name).
scale_fact: MEO orbits are an underused middle ground — fast enough for low-latency calls, fewer satellites needed than LEO. O3b is the only operator using it commercially.
